name: belezma-geoportail
description: Géoportail du Parc National de Belezma — Batna, Algérie

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @belezma/server && npm run build --workspace @belezma/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed --workspace @belezma/server
